import createContext.description: Type-safe context for loaders, actions and middleware. Not React's `createContext`.

createContext().description:
Creates a typed key for passing values through the request lifecycle.
Read and written with `context.get(key)` / `context.set(key, value)` — a default value makes reads safe before it is set.

context.get() in loader.description: Read a value a middleware placed into the request context.

context.set() in middleware.description: Store a value for the loaders and actions further down the chain.

import RouterContextProvider.description: Container for context values, returned from a custom server's `getLoadContext`.

RouterContextProvider().description:
Build the load context in a custom server.
With the middleware flag on, `getLoadContext` must return this instead of a plain object.
